values.note: FWP: 'There are 11 sites that can fit RV/trailers up to 35 feet in length and 12 sites limited to 25 feet in length.' ReserveAmerica lists 23 campsites, one of them pull-through.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/painted-rocks ('The park offers 23 campsites ... There are 11 sites that can fit RV/trailers up to 35 feet in length and 12 sites limited to 25 feet in length.') + audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json (23 'Campsite' rows: 20 Back-In, 1 Pull-Through, 2 unspecified), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json (ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630217: all 23 sites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no') + https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/painted-rocks ('There is no potable water available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Pack-in/pack-out; bear-resistant dumpsters for registered campers and food lockers for tent campers without a vehicle. Boat launch, dock and picnic shelter.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/painted-rocks (Amenities: 'Toilets (Vault)', 'Pack-in/Pack-out', 'Boat Launch', 'Dock', 'Picnic Shelter'; 'There is no potable water available at this campground.'; 'Bear-resistant dumpsters are available to registered campers', 'Tent campers without a vehicle may use available food lockers'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/painted-rocks-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?parkId=630217&contractCode=MT ('Status: Open year round.') + https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/painted-rocks ('Park: Open daily all year'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Only 6 of the 23 sites are reservable, and only Memorial Day through Labor Day, Thursday-Sunday; the rest are first-come, first-served. ReserveAmerica: 'Reservations must be made 2 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'

booking.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/painted-rocks ('There are 6 reservable campsites, available for reservation from Memorial Day through Labor Day, Thursday-Sunday only. The rest of the sites are first come, first served.') + ReserveAmerica Booking Window ('Reservations must be made 2 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana State Park on Painted Rocks Reservoir (West Fork Bitterroot River), Bitterroot Mountains SW of Darby, ~4,720 ft, in a remote pine-forest setting. The reservoir is drawn down: FWP, as of October 1, 2026, 'Due to dropping levels in Painted Rocks Reservoir, access to the water from Painted Rocks State Park is unavailable.' --Claude
summary: FWP park page + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 35-ft max, no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water, pack-in/pack-out, 6 reservable sites (Memorial Day-Labor Day, Thu-Sun) with the rest FCFS, the 3-month window and year-round status. Changed site count 25 -> 23 (FWP and RA both 23), cutoff 1 day (inherited) -> 2 days (RA), added pull-through and the booking deep link. Fees left as recorded (FWP gives only the statewide $4-$34 range). 7-night limit stays inherited (page silent). Note corrected (it said 2 sites to 35 ft and 23 to 25 ft; FWP says 11 and 12) and trimmed; FWP's Oct 2026 drawdown caveat added.
